name: Kalaam Telecom Data Center (Al Seef)
notes: Official Kalaam page: data center strategically located in the heart of Al Seef district, Manama; core facility for cloud and managed services. Directory corroboration (Data Center Map, colocationm.com) lists the same Al Seef facility. Capacity not disclosed.

name: iGA Government Data Center
notes: iGA official page states iGA manages and develops the government data center and provides IT infrastructure services; A for program existence, U for physical address/site (not public). Placed in Capital Governorate (Manama/government-campus context) per methodology; division unconfirmed.

name: National Bank of Bahrain (NBB) Data Center
notes: NBB launched its new data center (Tier III design certified by Uptime Institute) on the 6th floor of NBB headquarters in Manama after an 18-month infrastructure transformation supported by the Central Bank of Bahrain. Private enterprise facility in Capital Governorate.

name: AWS Direct Connect - Manama
notes: AWS announced its first Direct Connect location in Bahrain (Manama) in July 2019. Network access/colocation point in Capital, not a hyperscale campus; kept per methodology as cloud/network infrastructure evidence rather than a full datacenter record.

name: Beyon White Space Data Centre / Data Oasis
notes: Commissioned 2025-11-02 at Gateway Gulf 2025: 6,000 sqm White Space DC forming part of a 140,000 sqm Data Oasis site in southern Bahrain. Qareeb Data Centers manages/operates its first edge DC via long-term lease of this facility (Q1 2026). Facility area 6,000 sqm; campus 140,000 sqm; capacity MW not disclosed.

name: stc Bahrain / center3 Data Center Park (Al Qurain)
notes: stc Group/center3 with stc Bahrain: region's first data center park, 55,000 sqm site in Al Qurain, designed for up to 60 MW IT load, under construction; part of ~USD 300M investment with the 2Africa Pearl subsea cable extension. DCD (B) and stc press release (A) confirm; first phase announced Feb 2024.

name: AWS Middle East (Bahrain) Region me-south-1
notes: AWS Middle East (Bahrain) me-south-1 opened 2019-07-30 with 3 AZs (A-grade region evidence). AWS does not publish site addresses; the Askar (Southern Governorate) building placement is C-grade directory evidence. March 2026: ME-SOUTH-1 affected by drone-strike-related incidents (B-grade press; AWS Health Dashboard is A-grade current status).

name: Global Zone Data Center (Askar)
notes: PeeringDB lists Global Zone Datacenter in Askar and Manama-IX lists Global Zone as connected facility partner. Interconnection-oriented facility in Southern Governorate; PeeringDB-single-source evidence kept as C lead per methodology.

name: Batelco by Beyon Data Center (Hamala)
notes: Official Batelco page: Bahrain's first and only Tier III certified data center (Uptime Institute), Building 1095, Road 1425, Block 1014, Hamala; co-location services at multiple locations. DCD reported 2.75 MW at opening (B). Since Phase 3 of Beyon Solar Park (Nov 2025) the facility runs on 100% solar energy (Biz Bahrain, B).

name: AWS me-south-1 availability-zone site (Hamala, directory lead)
notes: Public facility directories place an AWS availability-zone site at Hamala (Northern Governorate). AWS does not disclose addresses, so this remains an unconfirmed C-grade lead; region existence itself is A-grade.

name: Beyon/Batelco additional data center (2023 plan)
notes: Beyon Group announced ~USD 250M investment in two subsea cables (incl. SEA-ME-WE 6) and a new data center (May 2023). Site not disclosed; may correspond to the later White Space DC at Data Oasis (Southern) - kept separate as an announced record pending evidence. Placed in Northern (Batelco Hamala base) as working assumption.
